items.q: my little Buford Oliver was there - Fess said, 'What can you do for him?' I said, 'He has a long way to go but he's a young man. I'll do the best I can.'

ctx.x: Oh, Shadow Wilson was in the band?

Sure he was while I was in the Army. The greatest natural drummer that ever lived. I said, "I'll be back in a minute." I think it took me about 6 weeks to get back because I had a lot of debriefing to do. Then when I came out to visit you with Fess and Cab with the Peters Sisters and all that and my little Buford Oliver was there - Fess said, "What can you do for him?"
